method.predictor_def: per-step global scalar a_j* = <G_j^1.3, G_j^1.0> / ||G_j^1.0||^2; scalar-predicted gradient Ghat_j^1.3 = a_j* * G_j^1.0 (identical to PR #47)
method.replay: RAdam replayed from the REAL extracted state (m0/v0/step0) over the full 20-step history, reading the update at every index t to obtain h_scalar_t and h_actual_t for all horizons t=1..20. Pure-numpy float32 RAdam (update independent of parameter value).
method.weighting: w = u1_t^2 (squared reference-update magnitude) on the effective support |u1_t| > 1e-5

validation.u1_vs_stored: per-K replay-vs-stored-final-update diff: max_abs_diff ~1e-8 median (float32-exact flag False at 9.3e-7 on rare near-zero-ref coords) — characterized as benign precision, not a logic error
